entities.summary: Mike Sparken is a pseudonym for Michel Poberejsky. He was a racing driver from France. He participated in one Formula One World Championship Grand Prix, at the 1955 British Grand Prix on 16 July. He finished seventh albeit nine laps down and scored no championship points.
